Objects.Name: operation_inputs
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE operation_inputs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id),owner TEXT NOT NULL,turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL)

Objects.Name: operation_scopes
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE operation_scopes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id),scope TEXT NOT NULL)

Objects.Name: operations
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,result BLOB,error TEXT NOT NULL)
